type: Author-authorized post-hoc engineering evaluation of an already closed development batch; not a confirmatory experiment or a retroactive gate change.
authorization: After discussing the limitations of screening only on physical residuals, the author said continue to the proposed separate complete frozen-terminal FEM evaluation. P2D's original failed physical gate and no-FEM-at-closure record remain unchanged. New outputs go outside its closed directory.
question: Does the P2D geometry-derived shared input construction have useful displacement, stress, spatial-distribution or engineering benefits that the physical-residual screen alone cannot establish? Report the scope of any gains and regressions.
weights: All 21 existing P2D terminal.pt states only, seed 260926, 400 accepted steps. Never choose saved intermediate checkpoints, retrain, adjust features or select locations from FEM errors.
references: Reuse the frozen P2A fine-reference evaluation arrays and their provenance/verification records for these identical cases. Verify SHA256 against the closed P2A inventory. Circle C1/C8 reference has 736000 integration points; L1 fine full-integration reference has 1704960. Use original quadrature area weights and known-element FEM displacement interpolation. Retain node-mean metrics separately. No remeshing or new FEM run.
reference_checks: Verify stored stress reconstruction, wall solid-offset sensitivity and area checks; confirm all current geometry/precision/weights match P2A. For the nine plain-model terminals enforce tensor-by-tensor equality with P2A and reuse their frozen prediction files with source hashes, rather than recomputing or copying them. All seven methods are evaluated at identical reference locations and with identical metric code.

evaluation.global: Area-weighted relative L2 errors of vector U and vector [sxx,syy,sxy]; point-mean L2 at the same integration points; original-node displacement L2 kept separate. Also weighted vector MAE and 50/90/95/99% absolute-error quantiles.
evaluation.spatial: Use existing geometry-only near-wall distance <=0.05, far-wall >0.05, and polygon corner-distance <0.02 masks. Full and regional errors; pairwise area fraction with lower vector error; worst 1% area contribution to squared error using weighted partial-bin integration. Save each point's U and S error norm and all prediction fields.
evaluation.wall: Arc-length-weighted hole-wall displacement L2 and MAE on 1024 prespecified points. Include the entire prescribed path, not selected favorable sections.
evaluation.engineering: Crown, invert, right and left wall displacement vectors; vertical and horizontal convergence. Save signed predictions, FEM values, absolute errors and vector errors. Avoid relative division by near-zero components.
evaluation.cost: Link original parameters, closures and peak-memory telemetry. No fair speedup, time-to-accuracy or total-efficiency claim from ordinary development durations. Separate current idle-machine timing confirmation required if later warranted.

interpretation: Keep residual scores distinct from solution errors. Primary mechanism contrast geometry_rbf_fourier versus uniform_rbf_fourier; strong performance contrast versus full half-Fourier. Show all seven methods and all cases, including anchored/independent hybrids. No automatic manuscript promotion or claim of universal superiority from a single training seed. Identify limited, physically interpretable benefit ranges for a future separately registered confirmation study, if justified. No new hypothesis is trained during this evaluation.
stop: Complete the 21 listed evaluations once. Stop on missing input, hash mismatch, invalid FEM provenance, nonfinite prediction or a concurrent project GPU computation. Do not change reference, mask, method list or checkpoint to improve a result. Preserve and explain any blocker.
